§ 01 · The Program

Real data,
real decisions.

From analyzing performance data and building dashboards, to handling data bias, forecasting demand, and leading business transformation through analytics, every scenario drops you into a genuine data situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Sixty-three foundations-focused scenarios and thirty-seven strategy-and-governance-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real analytical judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation a data or analytics professional faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across dashboards, forecasting, customer analytics, data governance, and decision-making.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound analytical judgment under real pressure.

§ 02 · 100 Scenarios

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Analytics Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping data and analytics professionals think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency with data isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–B2 learners who already work in, or aspire to work in, data and analytics roles in English — Mr. Gad Data, Analytics & Decision-Making is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the analytical moments you'll actually face.
